About dot.wave

One lead.
The right specialists.

A multidisciplinary consulting collective based in Indonesia, working across Indonesia and Japan. We connect insight, relationships, creative thinking and delivery around the work at hand.

The collective model

Built around
the work.

Different questions need different combinations of expertise.

We form the team around the scope, introduce the relevant specialists and keep one project lead as your primary contact. You work directly with the people shaping and delivering the work.

How we work

A practical path forward.

  1. 01

    Understand

    We agree on the objective, audience and constraints, then research the market and cultural context. The output is a shared brief and a practical view of the opportunity.

  2. 02

    Connect

    We map relevant partners, stakeholders and specialist expertise. Your project lead coordinates introductions and responsibilities so the working team is clear.

  3. 03

    Create

    We develop the strategy, concept or program with the people who will use it. Ideas are tested against local context, resources and the agreed objective.

  4. 04

    Deliver

    Delivery may mean recommendations, introductions, content, a launch or an on-the-ground program. We coordinate the agreed scope and review what the work achieved.

INDONESIA ↔ JAPAN

Cultural context.
Commercial relevance.

Understand expectations

Audience behavior, communication, decision-making and business conventions shape how an idea lands. We account for those differences from the brief onward.

Build useful relationships

We connect local knowledge with partner discovery, introductions and coordination between headquarters, local teams and stakeholders.

Make it work locally

Localization reaches beyond language into positioning, creative choices, production and delivery. Indonesia and Japan are our core strength, not a hard geographic limit.

How projects are run

Clarity from
the beginning.

Before work begins, we agree the scope, deliverables, team, timeline and fees in a formal proposal. Contracts and invoicing are handled through an Indonesian legal entity, named in the proposal. NDAs can be arranged before confidential material is shared.

An engagement can be a focused assignment or ongoing advisory. The project lead remains your primary contact throughout.

Why the name

dot.wave

Ideas + People. Infinite Possibilities.

The dot is a starting point: a question, an idea, a person. When the right points connect, they create movement. That movement becomes a wave. We connect insight, people and opportunities to move ideas forward.
